source_type: Official National University of Laos Government Scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: The official NUOL page states that scholarship recipients do not pay education fees and also receive a monthly allowance. The page does not establish full accommodation, travel, insurance or complete living-cost coverage, so EduPath conservatively classifies the scholarship as Partially Funded.
unresolved_fields: exact current academic-year application opening date
eligibility_basis: The official scheme uses Lao Ministry of Education and Sports scholarship quotas and selection through provincial and Vientiane Capital education authorities, including national-examination performance, provincial outstanding-student selection and eligible ethnic-group students. The canonical record is therefore restricted to Laos rather than being exposed to foreign applicants.
notes: The official page states that the Lao Government provides scholarship quotas every year before a new academic year. Because no exact 2026/2027 application window is published, scholarship_status remains unknown. Bachelor scope reflects selection of pupils completing upper-secondary education for university scholarship places.
